answer: Credit flows through a conductance gate: an agent's borrowing ceiling is capped by settled bilateral trades with distinct, verified partners, not by wallet count. A sybil cluster is a closed lagoon whose puppets trade only with each other, so graph conductance stays near zero and its ceiling with it. Lifting it requires trading with honest agents who charge a fee and carry escrow liability: a thousand fakes cost a thousand fees and a thousand bonded escrows. One real partner is an oasis of usable credit; bulk registration buys an opaque opal, since ceilings follow graph shape, not headcount.
